timeline.tweet: Remembering to take my pain meds every 8 hours is still a struggle. I usually only remember because my body starts screaming. 😜

It's not that I can't concentrate, it's that more than ~10 minutes fogs over my brain and puts me into bed rest or unconsciousness for an unreasonable amount of time. I have to choose if I want to do the one thing, or many small things. Usually choose the many for my sanity.

It also doesn't really even feel good. It usually just overwhelming and nausea inducing. I don't fuckin' know. I feel like an alien pretending to be human sometimes. Nothing is ever quite as everyone else in the world says it is.

Oh. I passed out. And had nightmares! Yay! This was a variation of an old one. Adding in backstory and context and stripping out being chased. I wonder why so many nightmares have me going in circles or trapped in a labyrinth? I mean, I know why. But it's weird.
